To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• Users were able to express themselves in a creative way using BrainBrush.

1) The multimodal BrainBrush application is usable and enjoyable for most participants, 2) the use of head movement and eye blinks are the preferred modalities and 3) the use of a BCI was considered fun and interesting, even though the reliability was low.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of multimodal BCIs to create a creative expression tool that can be used to explore and develop the creative potential of the human mind.
multimodal interaction and the development and application of multimodal BrainComputer Interfaces.
the development of multimodal Brain Computer Interfaces (BCI).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the BrainBrush is an innovative and promising application for creative expressiveness.
BrainBrush is a promising tool that allows people to express themselves in a creative manner.
BrainBrush is a promising application that allows users to express themselves creatively using multimodal BCI.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a multimodal system for creative expression that is based on the use of a P300 B300, eye blinks, and head movements.

BrainBrush is an interesting and fun application to use, especially for the use of the modalities head and eye movements, and the P300 BCI is an interesting addition, although the reliability is still too low for a reliable use.
we developed a novel multimodal BCI system that allows for creative expression and we evaluated the system with respect to the user experience of the participants.
The main takeaway from our work is that
multimodal BCI systems can be used to create art and that users are able to express themselves using the modalities.
the use of multimodal BCIs for creative expressivity is feasible and can be used by people without any prior knowledge of BCIs.
the use of BCS in the context of creative expression is a viable option and that the user experience of the BCI is positive.
